scope: Read-only transport boundary; no implementation, functional RED or vulnerability claim
facts: The canonical transport decodes a cloned401 and may announce an existing global session-ended event before returning to optional apiCall owner checkpoints.
The existing event carries a reason; its AuthProvider listener ends the current session.
qualificationLimit: Company dispatch/result/body/file handoffs are qualified. Delayed transport-wide session-end events across account replacement are not qualified by this slice.
